title: The Clark-Kushner condition for interacting reinforced random walks on finite graphs
summary: We establish the Clark-Kushner condition for a large class of interacting vertex-reinforced random walks on finite graphs, where the transition matrix $Q^i(x)$ of each walk depends on the joint vector $x$ of vertex occupation proportions and may have distinct rows. This allows one to study the dynamics of the vertex occupation measure by using the tools of stochastic approximation theory. However, the standard approach fails because the noise inputs are in our case not a martingale difference: they retain memory of the previous state.
